entries.Original: Welcome to Title Edit V3, a full remake of the original plugin.
entries.Translated: 欢迎使用 Title Edit V3，这是原插件的完全重制版。

entries.Original: If you encounter any issues that are not listed in the Known Issues or have information about them that you feel would be valuable you can report it via the feedback button in the Plugin Installer or the Title Edit post in #plugin-help-forum.
entries.Translated: 如果你遇到任何未列在已知问题中的问题，或掌握你认为有价值的相关信息，可以通过插件安装器中的反馈按钮或 #plugin-help-forum 中的 Title Edit 帖子进行报告。

entries.Original: If you're looking for more presets head over to Dalamud's official discord and check out the #preset-sharing channel.
entries.Translated: 如果你想要更多预设，请前往 Dalamud 官方 Discord 并选集 #preset-sharing 频道。

entries.Original: You can ctrl+click most sliders/drag inputs to enter values manually
entries.Translated: 你可以按住 ctrl 点击大多数滑块/拖动输入框来手动输入数值

entries.Original: You can alt+drag most drag inputs to change values slowly
entries.Translated: 按住 Alt 拖动大多数拖动输入可缓慢调整数值

entries.Original: You can shift+drag most drag inputs to change values rapidly
entries.Translated: 按住 Shift 拖动大多数拖动输入可快速调整数值

entries.Original: You can press ctrl+T to open this window while not logged in
entries.Translated: 未登录时可按 Ctrl+T 打开此窗口

entries.Original: Unless specifically otherwise said, these issues only affect the character or title screen
entries.Translated: 除非另有说明，这些问题仅影响角色或标题画面

entries.Original: World and character takes longer to load in when in housing zones
entries.Translated: 在住宅区中世界和角色加载时间较长

entries.Original: Certain BGM tracks will not loop
entries.Translated: 部分 BGM 曲目不会循环播放

entries.Original: With experimental layout enabled some VFX objects will play every time you load the scene often happening in instances
entries.Translated: 启用实验性布局后，部分 VFX 对象会在每次加载场景时播放，常见于副本中

entries.Original: Experimental layout saving being janky in general
entries.Translated: 实验性布局保存整体上不太稳定

entries.Original: These are not confirmed or researched, or have any date planned. They're something I personally think would be nice to have
entries.Translated: 这些内容尚未确认或研究，也没有计划日期。只是我个人觉得会不错的功能
角色选择界面支持宠物
角色选择界面支持饰品
角色选择界面支持情感动作

entries.Original: Layout editor allowing you to turn off/on certain parts of the map
entries.Translated: 布局编辑器可开启/关闭地图的特定部分

entries.Original: Speedas - initial Dawntrail update, full plugin rewrite to 3.0
entries.Translated: Speedas - 初始 Dawntrail -曦光旅路- 更新，插件完全重写至 3.0

entries.Original: attick - Title Edit 1.0 and many functions of 2.0
entries.Translated: attick - Title Edit 1.0 及 2.0 的许多功能

entries.Original: perchbird - Custom title screens and supporting features, maintaining the plugin before Dawntrail
entries.Translated: perchbird - 自定义标题画面及支持功能，在 Dawntrail -曦光旅路- 之前维护插件
ff-meli - BGM 正在播放代码
goat - 作为一个山羊般的个体

entries.Original: Override preset title screen logo setting
entries.Translated: 覆盖预设标题画面标志设置
覆盖预设标题画面颜色

entries.Original: Defines the cinematic that plays when idling in title screen for 60 seconds
entries.Translated: 定义在标题画面闲置60秒时播放的过场动画

entries.Original: Override preset title screen movie setting
entries.Translated: 覆盖预设标题画面影片设置

entries.Original: Preset that is used when no character is selected
entries.Translated: 未选择角色时使用的预设

entries.Original:
These characters are collected from the character select screen.
If any are missing go through all the worlds with characters created.
entries.Translated:
这些角色收集自角色选择画面。
如有缺失，请遍历所有已创建角色的世界。

entries.Original: Are you sure you want to delete the preset, this is unrecoverable.
entries.Translated: 确定要删除该预设吗？此操作无法撤销。

entries.Original: Use in-game time instead of a static time value.
entries.Translated: 使用游戏内时间而非固定时间值。

entries.Original:
You can only select mounts you have unlocked across all of your characters
Try logging into each character if you think any are missing
entries.Translated:
只能选择你所有角色中已解锁的坐骑
如果认为有遗漏，请尝试登录每个角色

entries.Original: This will also save your chocobo's gear and color
entries.Translated: 这也会保存你的陆行鸟装备和颜色

entries.Original:
Experimental feature to save world layout (e.g. changes that happen when you progress MSQ).
Works fairly well out in the world but often has issues in instances.
This will also increase the preset file size by around 50kb depending on the zone
entries.Translated:
用于保存世界布局的实验性功能（例如推进主线任务时发生的变化）。
在世界中运行良好，但在副本中经常出现问题。
根据区域不同，这还会使预设文件大小增加约 50kb

entries.Original: Experimental: Save world layout vfx objects
entries.Translated: 实验性：保存世界布局特效对象

entries.Original:
The game often leaves 'dead' vfx objects that will play on load that will play on load.
Unchecking this option should help with this specific issue.
entries.Translated:
游戏经常会留下“死”特效对象，这些对象会在加载时播放。
取消勾选此选项应有助于解决此特定问题。

entries.Original: There is no layout data collected for this preset, you need to go to the zone of this preset and click Apply Current next to the zone name
entries.Translated: 此预设未收集到布局数据，你需要前往此预设所在区域，并点击区域名称旁的“应用当前”

entries.Original: Only works in title or character select screen depending on the selected preset
entries.Translated: 根据所选预设，仅在标题画面或角色选择画面生效

entries.Original: The mount that was summoned when the character logged off, can be unmounted
entries.Translated: 角色登出时召唤的坐骑，可取消召唤

entries.Original: Continously track player location to show your character at the location you logged off
entries.Translated: 持续追踪玩家位置，以在登出位置显示角色

entries.Original: Periodically save incase of a crash or process termination
entries.Translated: 定期保存，以防崩溃或进程终止

entries.Original:
Experimental feature to save world layout (e.g. changes that happen when you progress MSQ).
Works fairly well out in the world but often has issues in instances.
entries.Translated:
实验性功能：保存世界布局（例如推进主线任务时发生的变化）。
在世界中运行良好，但在副本中经常出现问题。
实验性：在副本中保存布局

entries.Original:
Rescanning the layout after something changes may potentially cause stuttering on low-end systems.
You can switch that functionality off while specifically in instance
entries.Translated:
发生变化后重新扫描布局可能会导致低端系统卡顿。
你可以仅在副本中关闭此功能

entries.Original: If unchecked in-game time will be used instead of the time you logged off at.
entries.Translated: 若取消勾选，将使用游戏内时间而非你下线时的时间。

entries.Original: Don't restart the BGM when switching between scenes where the same BGM is used
entries.Translated: 在相同 BGM 的场景间切换时不重新播放 BGM

entries.Original: Add a button to character select screen that opens this window
entries.Translated: 在角色选择界面添加打开此窗口的按钮

entries.Original: Display the name of the current screen when loaded
entries.Translated: 加载时显示当前界面名称

entries.Original: Hide character names in character select
entries.Translated: 在角色选择中隐藏角色名

entries.Original: To hide your name when sharing character select presets
entries.Translated: 用于分享角色选择预设时隐藏你的名字

entries.Original: Use the logged in character's name as default preset author name
entries.Translated: 使用已登录角色的名字作为默认预设作者名

entries.Original: This will also remove them from the random pool
entries.Translated: 这也会将它们从随机池中移除

entries.Original: Selected preset does not exist or failed to load
entries.Translated: 所选预设不存在或加载失败

entries.Original: Selected group does not exist or failed to load
entries.Translated: 所选分组不存在或加载失败

entries.Original: The button highlight color will not be accurate, because the highlight image itself is blue, I tried to work around that by offsetting the color but it's not perfect
entries.Translated: 按钮高亮颜色将不准确，因为高亮图像本身是蓝色的，我尝试通过偏移颜色来规避，但并不完美

entries.Original: Last recorded character location, if nothing was recorded will default to the Nothing selected option
entries.Translated: 最后记录的角色位置，若未记录则默认为“未选择”选项
当前显示最后记录的位置

entries.Original: movie, adjust your settings or get the full game
entries.Translated: 影片，请调整设置或获取完整游戏

entries.Original: logo, adjust your settings or get the full game
entries.Translated: 标志，调整您的设置或获取完整游戏
